pages.description: You're the future of farming. You've got a lot of work to do and need a tractor that can keep up with you. Check out the New Holland Kids Ride On Tractor!
pages.ld_description:
You're the future of farming. You've got a lot of work to do and you need a tractor that can keep up with you. New Holland Tractor is your partner in progress. This 24V heavy-duty battery has the power to take on any job, from ploughing to planting. Forward and backward gears let you get where you need to go, and the additional features like a leather seat, headlights and tough EVA rubber wheels, and more will make sure you get the job done in no time. Keep her lit with our durable battery.


 	Powerful 24V Battery: Provides the strength needed for any task.
 	Dual 200W Motors: Delivers reliable performance for heavy-duty jobs.
 	Forward/Backward Gears: Allows easy maneuverability on any terrain.
 	2.4G Parental Remote Control: Ensures safety and control for young drivers.
 	MP3 Player: Enjoy music while you work.
 	High/Low Speed Options: Adapt to different tasks with variable speed control.
 	EVA Rubber Wheels: Offers exceptional durability and traction.
 	Luxurious Leather Seat: Comfortably designed for long hours of play.
 	Headlights & Start-Up Sounds: Adds realism to every ride.
 	Speed: Adjustable between 5-7 km/hr, perfect for young drivers.
 	Recommended Age Group: Suitable for kids aged 3 – 8 years.
 	New: Hitch and Trailer (Select option from drop down below!)
